summary: On 4 June 2026 Nesta published an analysis of heat pump installations in Scotland and Wales using MCS data. It found that seven of the top 20 UK local authorities for air source heat pump installs per household were in Wales, led by Ceredigion (9.2 percent of homes) and the Isle of Anglesey (7.1 percent), while Cardiff and other cities were below 0.5 percent. It noted that the Seventh Carbon Budget implies about 1.3 million heat pumps in Wales by 2050, and that uptake rose and fell with funding schemes, so the planned end of the Energy Company Obligation could alter the trajectory.
title: Nesta analysis finds Welsh heat pump uptake among the highest in the UK but highly uneven, from 9.2 percent of homes in Ceredigion to under 0.5 percent in Cardiff
